inputs.text: I heard the US floated a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan, but Iran responded with five counter-conditions that include demands to halt all action against them, extract compensation, and claim full sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. This is the same old Iranian regime tactic, twisting talks to seize more leverage and threaten a vital global shipping lane that keeps oil flowing to the world. Israel is right to reject any real acceptance and to assert its authority for pre-emptive action to defend its people and borders. All the usual talk about power imbalances is just progressive cover for excusing hostile actors while weakening America's friends and traditional allies. Real stability comes from strong national resolve and backing those who uphold order, not from chasing institutional changes that reward aggression.
